2: To the chief Musician. A Psalm of David. Jehovah answer thee in the day of trouble; the name of theGod of Jacob protect thee;
3: May he send thee help from the sanctuary, and strengthen thee out of Zion;
4: Remember all thine oblations, and accept thy burnt-offering; Selah.
5: Grant thee according to thy heart, and fulfil all thy counsels.
6: We will triumph in thy salvation, and in the name of ourGod will we set up our banners. Jehovah fulfil all thy petitions!
7: Now know I that Jehovah saveth his anointed; he answereth him from the heavens of his holiness, with the saving strength of his right hand.
8: Some make mention of chariots, and some of horses, but we of the name of Jehovah ourGod.
9: They are bowed down and fallen; but we are risen and stand upright.
10: Save, Jehovah! Let the king answer us in the day we call.
